summary: Sandbach United are riding high after securing back-to-back wins, with Joe Bevan recently etching his name into the club's history books by becoming the Ramblers' all-time leading scorer with 56 goals across just two seasons. The striker surpassed James Kirby's previous record of 54 goals with a brace in their last match, and with a full season still ahead there's plenty of time to add to his impressive tally. The team will look to continue their momentum as they travel to Foley FC in their next fixture.
